appDescription: A business vehicle logbook that automatically records each trip's odometer distance and keeps the trip purpose for the corporate tax vehicle log.

function.name: SET_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Record the type and purpose of the current or most recently finished trip in the vehicle logbook.

tripType.description: Category of the trip for the vehicle logbook.

purpose.description: Purpose of the trip as stated by the user.

visitPlace.description: Name of the company or place visited on a business trip.

function.name: GET_BUSINESS_RATIO
function.description: Get the total distance, business-use distance and business-use ratio of the vehicle for a period.

function.name: SHOW_DOWNLOAD_QR
function.description: Show a QR code on the vehicle screen so the user can download the vehicle logbook spreadsheet to their phone.

period.description: Period of the logbook to download.
